subject: def
title: (R)DEF.------ AF.DY.
description: Diagram in SR(TRS)II-40 (Social Reality / Trans-Information, Level Two), second of two on book p184, paired with v2-p184-1. Continues the definition argument: 'the significance of definition is directly related to the total concept of positive transformation. For the reality options of a given group are not separate from how that group perceives of itself.' (R)DEF (the reality of definition) is crossed with AF-DY (affinity dynamics): the question is what definition produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with affinity-dynamics — the (R) prefix marking that real definition (not imposed definition) is what links to real affinity-dynamics. PRIN-INFO (principle information) sits at the upper-center. (R)ATTN (the reality of attention) anchors the upper-right output. PHY-U-C (physical-universe conditions) sits between subject and partner. POL-DY (political dynamics) and P-PROG (positive progression) cluster on the right output. POST (postulation) feeds in from below-left. AF-DY itself is the partner-hub at the center-right. SPI-GH (spiritual ghost — Braxton's term for a spiritual presence that affects without obvious cause) anchors the lower-center. PART (participation) sits between subject and the lower output. AFI (affinity insight) anchors the bottom-center. Structural argument: definition-as-real crossed with affinity-dynamics is mediated by physical-universe-conditions as central hub. The (r) prefix on attention is load-bearing — only real attention (not spectacle-attention) connects principle-information to definition. The spiritual-ghost node is rare and load-bearing: it registers Braxton's structural commitment that the link from postulation through participation to affinity-insight runs through a *spiritual presence*, not just causal mechanism. Real definition therefore requires real attention plus spiritual-ghost as parallel mediators between principle-information and the affinity-dynamics output that constitutes group self-perception.
